name: falconsh
description: Run any coding agent with any LLM in absolute privacy.

scripts.build: tsup src/cli.ts --format esm --target node22 --clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/cli.js';fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+fs.readFileSync(f));" && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.check:all: npm run check:types && npm run check:format && npm run check:lint
scripts.launch:claude-auth-status: npm run dev -- launch claude -m auto auth status
scripts.launch:claude-it: npm run dev -- launch claude --verbose -m deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash:free
scripts.launch:claude-with-prompt: npm run dev -- launch claude --verbose -m deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash:free -p 'Who is your model maker?'
scripts.launch:claude-with-anthropic-gateway: npm run dev -- launch claude --verbose -m claude-haiku-4-5 -p 'Who is your model maker?'
scripts.launch:codex-auth-status: export CODEX_HOME=~/.falcon/codex && npm run dev -- launch codex -m auto login status
scripts.launch:codex-it: export CODEX_HOME=~/.falcon/codex && npm run dev -- launch codex -m deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash:free
